howItWorks.lead: From paycheck to shares in your own wallet, in plain words.

lifecycle.title: The paycheck lifecycle
lifecycle.body:
Your pay lands in your wallet as USDC, exactly as it does today. Paycheck Router sees the new balance, records the paycheck onchain and splits the invested share into one slice per asset.

Each slice is its own transaction. It swaps USDC for the asset through Jupiter, and the shares land in your wallet in the same transaction.

guard.title: The price guard
guard.body:
Before any slice buys, the program computes the minimum number of shares you must receive from a fresh Pyth price, or from a signed PreStocks mark for pre-IPO names. If the route would deliver less, the transaction reverts and the slice waits with a named reason.

The default band is 0.5% over the reference for listed stocks and 3% over the mark for pre-IPO tokens.

weekends.title: Weekends and market hours
weekends.body: Where Pyth publishes a 24/7 price, a slice can buy off-hours inside a band 0.5% wider. Where it doesn't, like SPYx and QQQx, the slice waits for the next open and says so.

allowance.title: The allowance
allowance.body: One setup signature gives the program a capped SPL allowance on your USDC account. It can spend up to that cap, only to buy the assets you picked, only into your wallet. When it runs low, the app asks for a top-up.

revoke.title: Stopping
revoke.body: Pause with one signature, or revoke the allowance from any wallet. After a revoke every slice waits and nothing moves. Slices that wait past your maximum wait expire, and the USDC never leaves your wallet.

custody.q: Can Paycheck Router move my money?
custody.a: Only up to your allowance, only to buy the assets you picked, only into your own wallet, and only inside the price band.

cost.a: 0.20% of each invested slice. Network fees and rent are covered.

weekends.a: Assets with a 24/7 Pyth price can buy inside a slightly wider band. Others wait for the next market open.

wait.a: The app shows the reason in one sentence, for example the market is closed or the price is too far over the reference. It retries on a schedule and expires at your maximum wait with the USDC untouched.

stop.a: Pause the router, or revoke the allowance from any wallet. Nothing can be spent after a revoke.

tax.a: No. You can export every execution with its cost basis as CSV for your own records; this isn't tax advice.

terms.title: Terms
terms.lead: The rules for using Paycheck Router.
terms.version: Version 2026-09-25. Draft for the fork demo; counsel reviews these terms before the mainnet launch.
terms.translationNotice: This translation is provided for convenience. The English version is binding.

software.title: Non-custodial software
software.body: Paycheck Router is software that helps you buy existing tokens from public liquidity into your own wallet. It never holds your funds and can't move them except as your allowance and the program's rules permit.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You may not use Paycheck Router if you are a US person, live in a comprehensively sanctioned country, or live somewhere an asset's issuer excludes. You confirm this when you set up.

fees.title: Fees
fees.body: Each invested slice pays 0.20% to the protocol treasury, taken inside the transaction. The program caps the fee at 0.50%.

advice.title: No advice
advice.body: Nothing in the product is investment, legal or tax advice. Preset splits are examples. You decide what to buy.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The software is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, the team isn't liable for losses from market prices, issuer actions, network conditions or third-party programs.

risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.lead: Read this before you invest a slice of your pay.

xstocks.title: xStocks
xstocks.body: xStocks give price exposure to US shares through Backed's SPV. They carry no voting rights. Dividends are reinvested through the token's multiplier. The issuer can pause or move tokens for regulatory reasons.

prestocks.title: PreStocks
prestocks.body: PreStocks give exposure to private companies through an SPV, with no shareholder rights. At IPO they convert on terms PreStocks sets, and tokens left unconverted after the deadline can expire worthless. Token prices can trade far above the mark.

contract.title: Smart contract risk
contract.body: The program and the programs it calls could contain bugs. It is open source and tested, and will be audited before the mainnet launch.

oracle.title: Oracle risk
oracle.body: Buys depend on Pyth prices and signed PreStocks marks. Freshness, confidence and band checks bound bad prices but can't remove the risk.

liquidity.title: Liquidity and premium
liquidity.body: Onchain pools can be thin, especially off-hours. The price guard makes a slice wait rather than overpay, so some slices may never buy.

usdc.title: USDC
usdc.body: USDC is issued by Circle, which can freeze addresses. If USDC loses its dollar peg, slices wait.

regulatory.title: Regulatory
regulatory.body: Rules for tokenized securities differ by country and are changing. Access can be restricted where they require it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What we store, why, and how to delete it.

collected.title: What we store
collected.body: Your wallet address, your router settings, the paychecks and slices it processed, your eligibility declarations with their version, your language and currency, and your email if you give it.

why.title: Why
why.body: To run your router, show your history, meet eligibility and sanctions obligations, and send notifications you asked for.

processors.title: Processors
processors.body: Cloudflare, Supabase, Privy, Resend, Helius, Alchemy, Chainalysis and Telegram process data on our behalf.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, GDPR and similar laws you can access, export, correct and delete your data, and object to processing.

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.body: Delete your account from Settings. Onchain records stay on the public chain; offchain data is removed.

restricted.title: Restricted countries
restricted.lead: Where Paycheck Router isn't available, and why.

us.title: The United States
us.body: Paycheck Router isn't available to US persons. The stock tokens it buys exclude the US.

sanctioned.title: Sanctioned jurisdictions
sanctioned.body: Countries and regions under comprehensive US, UN, EU or UK sanctions at the time of each check are blocked.

issuers.title: Issuer restrictions
issuers.body: Each issuer publishes its own restricted list. Where your country is excluded for an asset, that asset is hidden and the rest of the product still works.

check.title: How we check
check.body: We use your connection's country, the residence you declare and a daily sanctions screen of your wallet. A mismatch asks you to confirm.

status.title: Status
status.lead: Live health of each part of Paycheck Router.
status.unreachable: The status service can't be reached right now.

assets.title: Assets
assets.lead: Every stock and pre-IPO name a paycheck can buy, with live prices.
assets.pricesUnavailable: Live Pyth prices are unavailable right now; PreStocks marks still show.
assets.sources: Reference prices from Pyth, marks from the PreStocks API, onchain prices from Jupiter.

detail.converting: This asset is converting after its IPO. It can't be bought; holders convert before the deadline.
detail.rightsXstock: Price exposure to the underlying US shares through Backed's SPV. No voting rights; dividends are reinvested through the token's multiplier.
detail.rightsPreIpo: Price exposure to the private company through a PreStocks SPV. No shareholder rights; converts at IPO on PreStocks' terms, with a deadline after which unconverted tokens can expire.
detail.restricted: Not available to US persons or in sanctioned jurisdictions. The issuer may exclude more countries.

problems.notConfigured: This part of Paycheck Router isn't switched on here yet. Please come back later.
problems.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
problems.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
problems.ineligible: Paycheck Router isn't available for this account.
problems.invalid: That didn't go through. Check the details and try again.
problems.upstream: A service Paycheck Router relies on isn't answering. Try again in a minute.
problems.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
problems.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.

wallet.unavailable: {wallet} isn't connected. Open it, then try again.
wallet.wrongAccount: {wallet} is on another account. Switch it back to {address}, then try again.
wallet.rejected: The signature was cancelled. Nothing moved.

wallet.title: Fork demo wallet
wallet.body: Made in this browser for the demo fork. It holds nothing on mainnet, and no server ever sees its key.
wallet.exportBody: This key only matters on the demo fork. Keep it if you want to open the same wallet in another app.
wallet.exportFailed: The key couldn't be read from this browser.
wallet.resetBody: This browser forgets the wallet and starts again with a new one. Its fork funds and router stay with the old address.
wallet.resetFailed: The wallet couldn't be reset. Reload the page and try again.

paycheck.title: Send yourself a paycheck
paycheck.body: The fork's employer pays your wallet in USDC. Watch it split into stocks below.
paycheck.sent: {amount} is on its way. Slices start the moment it lands.
paycheck.failed: The paycheck didn't go out. Try again.

status.down: The demo fork isn't reachable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
status.resetting: The demo fork is resetting. It's back in a few minutes with fresh funds.
status.wasReset: The demo fork was reset. Start again: your wallet gets fresh funds.
